title: CHAPTER 1: THE DISCOVERY COUNTDOWN TO YOUR BIGGEST MISTAKE

segments.line: On a regular Tuesday morning, Pip walked outside and saw numbers floating above everyone's head.
Every person on the sidewalk had a glowing digital timer ticking down in bright light.
A barista pouring iced coffee had thirty-two years left on her calm green display.
Across the street, a nervous dog walker had barely twelve seconds left on his forehead. Pip
watched as the dog spotted a squirrel and yanked the leash with sudden force. The walker
tripped hard, sending three hot coffees splashing right into a passing police car. Pip
gasped, sprinted back into his apartment,
and stared into his bathroom mirror with dread. His own
numbers were glowing bright crimson, and they read exactly six days and fourteen hours. These
floating digits were not counting down to the day you quietly pass away. Instead, they were counting down to
the single biggest, most embarrassing mistake of your life.
Wait, because it gets worse when you realize what that red glow actually means.
The timer cannot be paused, covered with a hat, or hidden from anyone you meet. Pip
gripped the cold sink and wondered what terrible blunder was waiting for his future. Now the entire
world had to watch each other tick toward disaster every single second. And
nobody knew whether trying to stop their mistake would only make it happen sooner.
